admission.justification: The native provider discards the bound task server, and saved-request reconciliation must preserve existing agents while preventing an unbound replacement.

applicability: AR role starts selecting native Antigravity or Antigravity ACP under D890 and D896.
conditions: A fresh native Antigravity start returns ACP guidance before workspace preparation.
Saved native Retry looks up the exact recorded agent. Known absence settles HTTP 409 before native creation.
The admitted ACP path preserves the per-seat stdio definition and exact saved create input.
exclusions: The installed AR 3.0.3 and Paseo 0.15.4 Default witness does not establish Auto behavior or a live 0.16.2 observation.

evidence: Exact W4 red and W5 green regression on starting and unknown receipts, existing-agent delivery and exact ACP replay, and pinned 0.16.2 absence trace showing a lookup with zero creates. D896 live ACP witness on installed 0.15.4 and pinned 0.16.2 adapter source are distinct.

statement: Native Antigravity role starts refuse to create a seat because the plug-in drops the task tool server. Retry can reconcile the recorded seat. The Antigravity ACP provider receives its own stdio task server and replays the saved launch.
